summary.text: Software engineering graduate student with 2+ years of production experience across applied AI, mobile, and cloud backends, from LLM inference and multi-agent systems to React Native apps and serverless AWS.

byVariant.ai-llm: Software engineering graduate student with 2+ years of production experience focused on multi-agent AI systems and LLM inference optimization, from agent orchestration with LangChain, LangGraph, and Bedrock to speculative decoding and multi-framework inference benchmarking on GPU workloads.
byVariant.cloud-backend: Software engineering graduate student with 2+ years of production experience building cloud-native backends and REST APIs on AWS, from high-traffic API performance work to agentic GenAI workflow orchestration with Amazon Bedrock and serverless data pipelines.
byVariant.fullstack: Software engineering graduate student with 2+ years of production experience across full-stack and product engineering, from React and React Native frontends to FastAPI, Node.js, and AWS backends serving real users, with strong data structures and system design foundations.
byVariant.mobile: Software engineering graduate student with 2+ years of production experience in React Native and TypeScript, owning mobile features from component architecture and state management through App Store and Play Store release, with recent work in on-device vision AI and serverless AWS backends.
byVariant.academic: Software engineering graduate student at the University of Maryland with 2+ years of industry experience, strong data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems foundations, and a track record of mentoring peers in DSA and object oriented design.

byEmphasis.enterprise-ai: Software engineering graduate student with 2+ years of production experience building enterprise AI and platform systems, from RAG assistants over internal knowledge to agentic GenAI workflows across Salesforce, ServiceNow, and AWS.
byEmphasis.ml-infra: Software engineering graduate student focused on LLM inference and serving, from speculative decoding and KV cache analysis to head to head benchmarking of vLLM, SGLang, and TensorRT-LLM on Blackwell GPUs.
byEmphasis.mobile-product: Software engineering graduate student with 2+ years shipping production iOS and Android apps in React Native and TypeScript, with recent work running quantized vision language models fully on device.
byEmphasis.fullstack-product: Software engineering graduate student with 2+ years of full-stack product experience, from React and React Native to FastAPI, Node.js, and serverless AWS, comfortable owning a feature from UI to backend to deployment.

education.degree: Master of Engineering, Computer Software Engineering, Minor in Cloud Engineering
education.note: Relevant Coursework: Software Design, Cloud Computing, Virtualization, Cloud Security, Distributed Systems

bullets.text: Shipped a multi-agent RAG proposal assistant used daily by 20+ business development staff, auto-vectorizing every document on insert into a version-controlled SharePoint archive, with a Claude drafting agent and a separate evaluation agent that scores each RFI draft against the solicitation before reviewer handoff.

Engineered a company-wide AI meeting autopilot for 100 employees, chaining 5 Power Automate flows and Microsoft Graph API to convert Teams Copilot recaps into routed Jira tickets, mapping context to catch cross-meeting follow-ups and update existing tickets instead of duplicating, cutting up to 2 hours of manual entry per meeting.

Built a natural-language USAspending research agent whose query planner parses each prompt, routes to the correct API, and retrieves 1000+ contracts across any year range, generating Excel dashboards saved to SharePoint and delivered through Outlook and Teams.
Shipped a company-wide GenAI assistant used daily by 20+ staff, wiring REST and SOAP integrations across Salesforce, ServiceNow, and AWS into a normalized data layer with a React front end.
Engineered platform integrations across Salesforce, ServiceNow, and AWS, wiring REST and SOAP services into a normalized data layer that powers company-wide automation for 100 employees.
Streamlined meeting-to-ticket and opportunity intake with Python Azure Functions and Power Automate, deployed company-wide and saving up to 2 hours per meeting and 10 to 15 minutes per opportunity.
Shipped a retrieval assistant over a version-controlled SharePoint archive used daily by 20+ staff, pairing auto-vectorized ingestion with a React front end.

Built and shipped a retrieval augmented assistant over internal documentation and portals using LangChain and OpenAI APIs, cutting roughly 25 hours of manual lookup per week at 95% answer accuracy across 100 users.
Built and shipped a retrieval augmented assistant over internal documentation and portals with LangChain and OpenAI APIs, giving internal teams instant answers instead of manual lookups.
Designed agentic GenAI workflows across Salesforce, ServiceNow, and AWS using Amazon Bedrock for orchestration and REST plus SOAP integration into a normalized AWS data layer.
Built Salesforce and ServiceNow proof of concept integrations and earned the Salesforce Platform Developer I certification while wiring enterprise systems into a shared AWS data layer.
Delivered demo grade presales prototypes in Figma and reusable component libraries that accelerated client facing proposals.

Implemented speculative decoding from scratch across two GPUs in PyTorch and HuggingFace Transformers, applying the probabilistic rejection sampling acceptance criterion and establishing the draft to target cost ratio under which the technique delivers real 2 to 3x throughput on large target models.

Diagnosed a gap between 92% isolated draft agreement and 29% in-loop acceptance, tracing it to KV cache and verification input handling and showing that argmax draft selection beats temperature sampling for acceptance.
Benchmarked Qwen3-Coder-480B across vLLM, SGLang, and TensorRT-LLM on RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs, profiling time to first token, tokens per second, VRAM, KV cache growth, and multi-user scalability.
Caught that the official Qwen3-Coder FP8 checkpoint did not meet a 4-bit quantization requirement and escalated before compute was spent, preventing wasted GPU hours.
Reduced API response time from 75 seconds to under 10 seconds and increased throughput 4x by restructuring SQL joins, indexing high-traffic tables, and adding a Redis caching layer.
Architected RESTful backend services for a tourism platform serving 10K+ daily bookings, cutting production defects 40% and accelerating feature delivery 25%.
Designed a real-time interview system with WebRTC and Socket.IO supporting 100+ concurrent sessions at sub-200ms latency.
Built and shipped a production iOS and Android credentials wallet app and implemented 15+ blockchain webhooks enabling real-time verification workflows.
Integrated Firebase and Twilio for push notifications and secure user communication, improving real-time engagement across iOS and Android.
Led mobile release cycles in Xcode and Android Studio, resolving critical UI defects and deploying stable updates to the App Store and Play Store.
Developed twin React Native apps for a senior-living network, improving operational coordination by more than 35% through real-time task sync and notifications.
Built 50+ cross-platform mobile screens with React Native and Redux Toolkit, delivering modular UI systems that improved development velocity and consistency across iOS and Android releases.
Reduced video playback stutter by 70% and improved load time by 1.3 seconds through async loading and client-side caching.
Partnered with designers to implement responsive and adaptive React Native UI flows, tightening consistency across screens and release cycles.
Automated multilingual data extraction across 5+ regional languages with Python and Selenium, lifting NLP classification accuracy from 78% to 93%.
Curated structured datasets that supported 5000+ regional-language Wikipedia contributions.

Built Locra, an Android-first multimodal AI assistant in React Native, TypeScript, and Expo that runs a quantized Qwen3-VL-2B vision language model fully on device through llama.rn, with no internet needed after model download.

Developed an Android-first multimodal AI assistant in React Native, TypeScript, and Expo that runs a quantized Qwen3-VL-2B vision-language model fully on device via llama.rn, pairing on-device Whisper speech-to-text with a Kotlin native module that enforces model integrity and a hard offline guarantee.

Added on-device speech to text with Whisper (whisper.rn) and live capture via Vision Camera, and enforced a hard offline guarantee through a network gate and a Kotlin native module that verifies model integrity before inference.

Engineered an on-device retrieval and memory layer over SQLite and MMKV, combining vector embeddings with lexical fallback and context compaction so the 2B model sustains long, coherent conversations within tight mobile memory limits.

Benchmarked competing on-device vision language models on physical devices and hardened the release with a quality evaluation harness, a broad contract and integration test suite, and GitHub Actions CI with EAS builds.

Built a multi-agent system with AutoGen, LangChain, and FAISS vector search where specialized SDE, PM, and QA agents generate architecture insights, API docs, and schema analysis using GPT-4 with RAG over codebase embeddings.
Designed resumable long-running analysis sessions with a FastAPI backend and Streamlit interface for interactive, context-aware code exploration.

Built a full-stack event platform in React, FastAPI, and MongoDB on Kubernetes with CAS SSO, JWT role-based access control, and Stripe payments via webhooks, supporting 100+ concurrent users at sub-200ms API response times.
Built CI/CD pipelines and automated waitlist and notification workflows, enabling reliable feature delivery in an Agile team.

Designed a serverless pipeline on AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and SQS with CloudFormation and GitHub Actions, using dedicated upload, processing, and analytics functions with auto-scaling behind CloudFront to absorb bursty load at low idle cost.
Hardened the platform with network policies, RBAC, and security scanning that reached zero critical vulnerabilities, and scaled EKS workloads from 2 to 10 pods behind a load balancer.

Built a real-time collaborative whiteboard in Next.js and TypeScript with WebSocket sync, PostgreSQL and Prisma, and a Turborepo monorepo, supporting multiple users drawing simultaneously with live updates.
Built a peer-to-peer video conferencing app with WebRTC, React, TypeScript, and Node.js, supporting multi-participant calls, screen sharing, recording, and in-call chat.
Built a domain-specific support assistant with FastAPI, OpenAI APIs, and a Hugging Face fallback that works offline, using Redis caching and RAG for low-latency answers.
Built a healthcare assistant at Bitcamp with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React, and the Gemini API, delivering conversational patient support with low-latency responses.

projects.role: Desktop Job Tracker with AI Resume Generation

bullets.text: Built a React and Electron desktop app that captures postings via a bookmarklet and generates tailored one-page resumes, where an LLM selects bullets from a fixed content bank and deterministic code renders LaTeX to PDF through Tectonic with a compile and verify one-page loop.
Built a cross-platform React Native app with a Node.js backend and SQL database, featuring real-time activity tracking, push notifications, and an analytics dashboard across iOS and Android.
Prototyped multi-agent orchestration workflows with the Google Agent Development Kit, exploring tool use and agent coordination patterns in Python.
